items.details: Z-target the eye and wait for its red vulnerable signal before using the Slingshot. When she is stunned, move in for sword hits, then step back and watch her next action. If she climbs to the ceiling, keep the eye in view: a well-timed shot can interrupt her before eggs fall. If eggs do appear, destroy them promptly rather than letting several small enemies distract you. Break away to reset your position instead of swinging continuously beneath an invulnerable boss.

details_i18n.pt: Use a mira Z no olho e espere o sinal vermelho de vulnerabilidade antes de disparar a Slingshot. Quando ela ficar atordoada, aproxime-se para golpear com a espada e recue para observar a próxima ação. Se subir ao teto, acompanhe o olho: um tiro preciso pode interrompê-la antes da queda dos ovos. items.details: After obtaining the bow, shoot the Poe portraits from far enough away that the ghost does not retreat before the arrow lands. Follow it between the remaining pictures, then fight it in the room. The eye above the twisted hallway changes its orientation, opening a different route to the Boss Key; return and toggle it again when the other orientation is needed. Later, assemble the picture blocks before time expires. In the final four-copy encounter, watch for the copy that spins when it appears.

details_i18n.pt: Após obter o arco, atire nas pinturas de Poe de uma distância que impeça o fantasma de fugir antes da flecha. Siga-o pelas pinturas restantes e enfrente-o na sala. O olho sobre o corredor retorcido muda sua orientação e abre outra rota até a Boss Key; volte e altere-o de novo quando precisar da outra posição. Depois, monte a imagem com os blocos antes do fim do tempo. No encontro com quatro cópias, observe a que gira ao aparecer.

items.details: During the horseback phase, watch the paintings and shoot the rider that actually emerges through the glowing portal; the false rider turns back. Keep moving if you misread the picture and lightning begins. Once Phantom Ganon fights on foot, face him and return the energy ball with timed sword swings until it strikes him. Close the distance for a short sword attack while he is down, then prepare for the next exchange. Preserve arrows for the mounted phase rather than firing at a returning decoy.

details_i18n.pt: Na fase montada, observe as pinturas e atire no cavaleiro que realmente sai pelo portal luminoso; o falso volta para dentro. Movimente-se se errar a pintura e os raios começarem. Quando Phantom Ganon lutar sem montaria, fique de frente e devolva a esfera de energia com golpes de espada no momento certo até acertá-lo. Aproxime-se para atacar brevemente enquanto ele estiver caído e prepare a próxima troca. Reserve flechas para a fase montada em vez de disparar contra uma cópia que recua.

Recheck these two locations before repeating the entire dungeon or assuming the save is permanently stuck.

items.details: When the Master Sword is knocked away, use the Megaton Hammer or an optional suitable sword to attack Ganon's exposed tail. A Light Arrow to the face can create an opening to get behind him, but keep some magic and arrows available rather than firing continuously. Recover the Master Sword as soon as Zelda opens the safe opportunity. Continue attacking the tail with it in the final phase and use the Master Sword for the finishing blow when prompted. The original ending does not create a playable post-Ganon world.

items.details: Prepare the normal travel routes before accepting perishable items. In the N64 original, the Odd Mushroom allows three minutes to reach Granny's rear potion shop in Kakariko; the Eyeball Frog allows three minutes from King Zora to the Lake Hylia scientist; the eye drops allow four minutes from the laboratory to Biggoron at the summit. Warp songs spoil the timed delivery, so travel overland. Epona helps across Hyrule Field but is not a reason to skip learning the route. If an item spoils, return to its giver and retry.

items.details: Learn Epona's Song from child Malon first. As an adult, pay Ingo for riding practice, summon Epona with the song and mount her. After another paid session, speak to Ingo while mounted to accept the 50-rupee race. Win twice, keeping an inside line and spacing carrot boosts so you do not exhaust the entire meter early. Ingo then blocks the gate; accelerate straight toward a jumpable fence or outer wall to leave with Epona. She is optional for the main route because the Longshot can cross Gerudo Valley.

details_i18n.pt: Aprenda Epona's Song com Malon na infância. Como adulto, pague a Ingo pelo treino, chame Epona com a canção e monte nela. items.details: Stand on the Triforce emblem before the large royal tombstone and play Zelda's Lullaby. Enter the opened tomb, clear the Keese that control the first locked door and pass the ReDeads carefully. Read the inscription in the last chamber to learn the Sun's Song. Outside, it switches day and night; against ReDeads and Gibdos, it can freeze them temporarily. This is an optional song with practical uses, not a prerequisite for obtaining the three Spiritual Stones.
